title: Reduce migration process overhead without weakening compatibility gates

acceptance_criteria.description: Reuse existing plans and evidence, combine routine bookkeeping, start direct service validation early, scope repeated checks and honor delegated review transparently; preserve upstream defaults, oracle separation and substantive approval gates.
acceptance_criteria.required_evidence: Self-review of consistent root/task/plan/guardrail/template guidance under the user request; no validator relaxation or service approval.

acceptance_criteria.description: Migration validation, scope and whitespace checks pass with code/defaults unchanged.
acceptance_criteria.required_evidence: make migration-check migration-test, scoped check and git diff --check at the policy revision.

handoff: User requested reduced future overhead; documentation-only process change.
